requirements.description: Preferred energy class C or better. Energy class C or better is the set A1, A2, A3, A4, B, C.
User wants the dwelling located near green spaces. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.

The user explicitly requires a gross floor area of at least 95 sqm, so surface_area is filtered with a >= threshold. Capacity for four people, energy class, proximity to green spaces, and the future nursery use are not reference columns or gross-area metrics, so they are not converted into filters.

output.explanation: Applies the four extracted requirements: surface_area >= 95 (hard minimum), a 3.0 km haversine radius around 45.0677551, 7.6824892, energy_class limited to A1–C, and green >= 74. Conditions are ordered strictest to softest. Results are sorted by distance from the coordinate, as the location is present. No property_type or other filters were added because they were not in the extracted requirements.
